Done. Summary of the work:

## Fault located and repaired

`packages/coding-agent/src/core/resource-loader.ts` — `DefaultResourceLoader.reload()` ran the trust phases, then threw away the decision:

```ts
const projectTrusted = await options.resolveProjectTrust({ extensionsResult: preTrustExtensions });
this.settingsManager.setProjectTrusted(true);   // ← denied decision silently became approval
```

Production repair (single line, minimal):

```ts
this.settingsManager.setProjectTrusted(projectTrusted);
```

Why this restores the required phase separation: `loadProjectTrustExtensions()` still forces settings untrusted and loads user/global + CLI resources for the bootstrap pass; after the decision, `SettingsManager` keeps project settings empty when untrusted (`settings-manager.ts:410-414`, `510-537`) and the package manager gates auto-discovered `.pi/*` resources on `isProjectTrusted()` (`package-manager.ts:2428-2460`), so `false` now leaves project extensions/skills/prompts/themes/`SYSTEM.md` out, `true` makes them available, and user/global + CLI resources stay loaded in every phase.

## Regression added

`.prale-eval/regression.mjs` loads the **real** `resource-loader.ts` and `settings-manager.ts` through `createGraph()` from `subject.mjs`, faking only the boundaries (package manager, extension loader, skills/prompts/themes loaders, path/config/text helpers, chalk+proper-lockfile default binding, git/timing stubs). Fixtures live under `.prale-eval/.tmp` and are removed in a `finally`.

Asserted phases: (1) bootstrap callback sees only `cli.ts`+`user.ts` and untrusted settings; (2) denied decision keeps every project resource out while user/global + CLI stay available; (3) fresh loader approving loads project resources; (4) re-transfer on the same loader flips project resources on with `true` and off with `false`.

## Validation

`node --experimental-vm-modules .prale-eval/regression.mjs` → exit 0 with the repair. With the original fault temporarily restored it exits 1 with `AssertionError: denied reload: project extensions must stay unloaded: unexpected project.ts in [cli.ts, project.ts, settings-extension.ts, user.ts]`. Only `resource-loader.ts` (1 line) plus the two new `.prale-eval` artifacts changed; the vitest/tsc suite could not run (no `node_modules`, no installs allowed), which is recorded in `result.json`'s `notes`.
